description: This Java source file defines the MediaCodecWrapper class, which simplifies interaction with Android's MediaCodec API for media decoding. It manages media buffer queues, handles codec configuration, and provides callback interfaces for format changes and decoded sample data.

classes.name: MediaCodecWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class that simplifies media decoding using MediaCodec, managing buffer queues, callbacks for format and sample data, and providing static methods for codec creation.

classes.name: MediaCodecWrapper.OutputFormatChangedListener
classes.description: Interface for callback when the output media format changes.

classes.name: MediaCodecWrapper.OutputSampleListener
classes.description: Interface for callback to receive decoded media samples.

methods.name: stopAndRelease
methods.description: Stops the media codec and releases resources.

methods.name: getOutputFormatChangedListener
methods.description: Returns the registered output format change listener.

methods.name: setOutputFormatChangedListener
methods.description: Registers a callback for format changes and sets the handler.

methods.name: fromVideoFormat
methods.description: Creates a MediaCodecWrapper configured for the given video format and surface.

methods.name: writeSample
methods.description: Feeds media sample data from a ByteBuffer into the decoder, with optional crypto info.

methods.name: writeSample
methods.description: Feeds media sample data from a MediaExtractor into the decoder, handling secure and non-secure data.

methods.name: peekSample
methods.description: Peeks at the next sample in the output buffer queue to retrieve its info.

methods.name: popSample
methods.description: Releases and optionally renders the next output sample, notifying listeners.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Synchronizes the internal buffers with the MediaCodec's current state.
